scope: Recorded-claim, source-map and evidence-path integrity; not all-feature runtime or live-provider certification

record_consistency.scope: Recorded-claim consistency only; this command does not run acceptance tests or certify runtime behavior.

requirements.acceptance_check: Each frozen feature has precise source evidence, an ARC mapping and a concrete reproducible acceptance check.
Record observed build/refine/review/activate/test/edit/deactivate/rollback behavior, separating static shipped evidence from runtime observations.
All 31 pinned entries retain source identifiers, aliases, implementation mapping and behavioral checks.
Upgrade a frozen legacy workspace twice; inject failures at every write boundary; restore a verified backup with conversations, graphs/YAML, schedules and artifacts intact.
No entry becomes accepted/configured/live-verified merely because it appears in the catalog.
Freeze exact baselines/catalogs and requirement clauses; pass upgrade/recovery fixtures and required regressions with zero unexplained skips.
Stream a response containing Markdown, code, table, link and citations; verify progressive formatting/copy at phone/tablet/desktop sizes.
Preview every listed format using immutable private artifacts; verify mobile navigation and unsupported/oversized-file errors.
Attempt script, event handler, form, external image/CSS/frame and credentialed URL payloads; observe no execution or external request.
Open old and new citations after document replacement; each resolves its pinned revision/page and rejects another user.
Replay a branching delegated workflow with a tool, approval and artifact; compare complete event order/state to live execution.
Disconnect before/after acknowledgement and during mutation; reconnect observes the same task and never duplicates an external effect.
Authorized embedded agent chat works while missing/revoked identity and unavailable agent access fail.
Pass the cited streamed conversation and inspectable execution history scenario across all three viewport classes.
Create/edit/archive/restore/export/import a project with default agent, instructions, documents and related chats.
Index all five families within bounds; oversized, corrupt and interrupted jobs fail safely and remain inspectable.
Inject failure during replacement and publication; readers see a complete previous or complete new index, never mixed/partial chunks.
Run lexical locally without network; separately configure local and API embeddings and verify only the chosen endpoint receives accessible content.
Exercise each mode, missing local service and external failure; display the actual mode and observe no unselected provider request.
Cross-user/workspace queries and citation downloads cannot reveal document chunks, names or bytes.
Queue a run, replace documents/change settings before execution, and verify the original permitted revision/settings are used.
Run the full upload/question/citation/replacement scenario through Studio and restore/reopen the old conversation.
Design and refine a prompt, edit variables/tags/shortcut, fill required values, compare versions and restore a selected version.
Search/select suggestions in both surfaces, enter variables and invoke an existing /prompt-id successfully.
Create a draft schedule conversationally, inspect it, then create each manual mode without automatic enabling.
Verify stored zone/upcoming times and actual dispatch across gap/fold without missing valid or repeating ambiguous occurrences.
Stop workers across multiple occurrences; restart two workers and observe one coalesced recurring run and one overdue one-time run.
Pause across due times, inspect history, explicitly resume and verify only policy-allowed dispatches occur.
Use the variable prompt from a reviewed weekday 09:00 Europe/Rome schedule; verify restart and both DST transitions.
Build and execute all node kinds in one versioned workflow; invalid references/types fail before effects.
Inject schema failure, timeout and safe retry; verify handlers run as defined and completed nodes are not repeated after recovery.
Validate each default boundary and administrator override; resource use stays bounded and unauthorized overrides fail.
Interrupt before/after an external mutation, resume gates, and verify no automatic retry can duplicate an uncertain effect.
Round-trip representative non-external platform reference agent/workflow fixtures; unsupported constructs produce complete preflight diagnostics and no saved state.
Create/reopen/update a build using every supported resource; dependency references resolve and stale edits are blocked.
Inspect each changed component and dependency, activate/test/deactivate, then rollback a release with consistent status and health.
Edit after review and reject activation; configure/test/enable each required resource explicitly before the exact reviewed revision activates.
Validate/plan/apply/export through CLI; any preflight failure leaves all definitions/resources unchanged.
Reproduce the installed reference lifecycle using Nexus, reopen/edit later and rollback; preserve resources, approvals and unsupported-field reporting.
Independent MCP clients/servers verify all three transports, each auth mode, selected tools and scoped delegated token refresh/revocation.
Import representative 3.0/3.1 documents; selected validated operations invoke the configured account and unsupported constructs fail preflight.
Run scoped read-only and reviewed-write fixtures against each database family; cancellation/timeout and pool isolation remain correct.
Configure each adapter, invoke a valid operation, reject invalid scope and confirm mutations require reviewed permission.
Independent peer exchanges typed/file/artifact data, continues one task, receives scoped push updates and verifies actual cancellation outcome.
Run the same task lifecycle contract over each enabled binding for 0.3 and 1.0 without duplicate execution.
Compare advertised capabilities with provider support; race cancellation against completion and report the observed outcome accurately.
Use each entrypoint with scoped authentication, reject forged identities and verify all execute the same approved task service.
Independent protocol peers pass the complete matrix across every supported transport and version.
Run each tool, retain precise citations/artifacts, enforce iteration/data bounds and verify isolated worker outputs.
Explicitly configure each provider operation; validate input/output artifacts and errors without selecting another provider.
Render all supported embed types with bounded work; reject executable expressions, unavailable artifact revisions and unauthorized state.
Configure and invoke geographic/ruleset queries with structured results, source evidence and invalid-input checks.
Each of the twelve has usable setup, actual bounded invocation, example and semantic behavior test; listings alone do not pass.
For every alias document the reused/native implementation and test the entry-specific behavior, not just transport connectivity.
Browse without processes/install hooks; inspect required versions/setup, fail readiness on missing dependencies and activate only after explicit configuration.
Run actual analysis/ImageMagick/object detection workers; observe only selected mounts, bounded resources and no host fallback/network.
Before every activation show exact prerequisites/account billing and reject missing configuration without claiming authentication/quota.
Audit all 31 pinned entries; accept only supported equivalents with semantic tests/examples or one of the explicit external platform exclusions.
Record in browser, transcribe locally/API, synthesize locally/API and play on device using the explicitly chosen profile.
Select voice/language/speed, stop and opt into autoplay; cancel/crash processing and verify private temporary bytes are removed.
Create a snapshot with only selected immutable artifacts; later chat/file edits do not change it and only granted recipients can read it.
Verify default rejection, token entropy, expiry and individual/global revocation; public readers cannot mutate or discover unrelated data.
Rate/comment, inspect/export only owned history and promote a reviewed record to an evaluation dataset without exposing another owner.
Navigate from feedback to evaluation, compare releases and inspect dependency/resource health with existing role limits.
Inspect parent-child relationships and available token usage, then collect redacted scoped traces/metrics with both exporters.
Install on target personal VM, validate TLS/auth/private routes, upgrade/restart and restore a full verified backup.
Run voice/share/feedback/evaluation/release/health/backup restore across desktop/mobile and target VM after all earlier acceptance gates pass.
All target evidence points to fixed versions/hashes; later upstream additions are a separate backlog.
Retrieve the same exact entries and metadata from recorded commits.
No external platform dependency is required; preserve Nexus transport/auth/runtime and deployment target.
Local and VM modes pass existing ownership/role checks without Kubernetes prerequisites.
After each milestone, execute an authorized Codex/Claude Code run through existing subscription adapters, verify Nexus identity boundaries and complete key phone flows.
No cloud request occurs until explicitly selected; no error triggers a different embedding provider.
Both local and API modes appear, configure and perform transcription and synthesis independently.
Fresh workspace rejects public shares; enabling/expiry/revocation preserves immutable read-only scope.
Every generated-code path uses the restricted worker and fails visibly when unavailable.
Install and operate with current frontend and no mandatory frontend build.
Each framework capability has a consuming example without reusable logic in the example.
One ownership/credential/job policy applies across new and existing entrypoints.
Migrate and read frozen versions of each family and reject unsupported future versions without mutation.
Same project ID in separate workspaces cannot cross-read search, documents or citations.
Exercise previous request fixtures unchanged and all new routes with existing authorization.
Old consumer reads output unchanged; rich consumer receives typed metadata without losing artifacts/events.
Round-trip same versioned workflow across all surfaces; frozen graph/YAML fixtures still execute.
Export/backup configurations contain references without literal credentials; revoked identity cannot resolve them.
Install built package with chosen extras and serve every frontend asset without external CDN/build steps.
Open and execute frozen previous-version data after repeated upgrade and restore.
Attempt direct URL/token/reference spoofing for every named resource without disclosure.
Fault-inject each boundary and prove no unconfirmed external mutation repeats.
Run full workflow matrix with deterministic outputs, bounded execution and preserved gates.
Every adapter has a semantic fixture and separately classified real/local/account evidence; unavailable accounts never become skips.
Run primary lifecycle flows at three widths with keyboard/accessible names/touch; exercise microphone permission states on physical devices.
Restore a checksummed backup into an isolated destination and verify every named family including remote artifact prerequisites.
Required suite reports no unexplained skips and optional readiness report explicitly lists each missing prerequisite.
Each milestone exit has evidence before acceptance; Studio regression flows stay usable.
Every accepted milestone links all five required delivery artifacts.
Completion declaration is mechanically blocked unless every in-scope requirement gate passes; separate pending-live list remains explicit.
Changing baselines requires an explicit new target record and preserves original acceptance history.

Physical microphone/playback/touch/install; selected provider credentials, permissions, quality and API billing
Recovered-host browser/OAuth and full OS/ingress/daemon/power-loss operation
Another physical Mac; installed Linux/Windows and Windows signing; genuine prior-release/schema migration; later-source builds only on explicit request

optional_local_extension: Offline before/after evaluation-report comparison; not an unmet frozen requirement
notes: The 12 implemented inventory records are constraints, not 12 unfinished adapters.
Catalog aliases and four exclusions count as separate frozen rows, not independent implementations.
Historical observations and pending prose remain unchanged; the companion Markdown identifies superseding evidence.
Zero aggregate inconsistencies does not establish zero behavioral gaps.
Existing live checkpoints retain their own exact source/environment scope despite unchanged inventory live flags.
Ignored operator-owned baseline documents were not force-added; resolved hashes do not distribute their contents.
Recent checkpoint test totals overlap and are not summed or relabeled as rerun.
